name: claude-context-toolkit
description: Personal marketplace bundling the a-plus-plus goal compiler and its companion workflow skills (tdd-workflow, rust-testing, santa-method, config-gc) together with the context layer they assume: caveman (terse output style), rtk (bash output filter) and code-review-graph (incremental review graph) hooks. context-mode is a separate dependency installed from its own marketplace (mksglu/context-mode).

plugins.name: context-toolkit
plugins.description: Bundles the a-plus-plus goal compiler and the workflow skills it names (tdd-workflow, rust-testing, santa-method, config-gc), the caveman terse-output skill, the rtk bash-output-filter hook, the code-review-graph incremental review-graph hooks, and a context-discipline layer: per-session reading/command/turn rules, a symbol outline in place of whole-file Reads over 20 KB (measured 93.4% fewer tokens with every sampled declaration still complete), and a UI Automation helper that replaces screenshots on Windows. Run /context-toolkit:setup once per machine to install the underlying binaries (rtk via cargo, code-review-graph via pip) and add the context-mode marketplace, then /context-toolkit:verify to confirm the reduction on that machine.
